summary: The comment opposes conditionally tying E-Rate decisions to screen-time limits for parental oversight of online content, emphasizing transparency and parental rights to understand how content is evaluated and restricted.

claims.argument: Parents should be able to understand how online content is evaluated by schools
claims.evidence_quote: Parents should be able to understand how online content is evaluated by schools, what types of material are restricted or permitted, and how parents can raise concerns.
